data.formal_statement:
namespace ZipfLaw

theorem zipfPMF_sum_eq_one (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (s : ℝ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, zipfPMF N s k = 1 := by sorry

end ZipfLaw
data.natural_language_statement:
For every integer $N\ge1$ and real exponent $s$,
$$\sum_{k=1}^{N}f(k;N,s)=\sum_{k=1}^N\frac{1}{H_{N,s}\,k^s}=1 .$$

This is the statement that $H_{N,s}$ is the normalization constant of the Zipf distribution.
data.source: Wikipedia, "Zipf's law" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zipf%27s_law), snapshot uploaded by the proposer, section "Formal definition" (PMF $f(k;N,s)=\frac{1}{H_{N,s}}\frac{1}{k^s}$, $H_{N,s}$ the normalization constant).
